name: Nurse no Obenkyou Nyuumon Hen ~Yasashiku Wakaru Kiso Kango Gijutsu~
original_name: ナースのお勉強 入門編～やさしくわかる基礎看護技術～
source:
Tateyasu joins a nurse training school and starts living at school dormitory. He is one and only male student there, so this means he is surrounded by girls all the time!

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Tateyasu进入护士培训学校，并开始在校内宿舍生活。他是那里唯一的男学生，这意味着身边始终围绕着女孩！
